purpose: Teach: キッカケ/曇っ/わるい/じつに/ていねい/いまどき/ことさら/べつに

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんとの思い出が、お絵描きを始めるキッカケになったわね
lines.en: You know, it was spending time with Grandpa that made you want to start drawing, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, noticing tone. Soft realization in the voice. Looking at Sho with warmth and quiet certainty. No question mark in delivery — stating something she already knows.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日は空が曇ってるからお出かけは難しいかな
lines.en: Mom, the sky's pretty cloudy today. Do you think we'll be able to go out?
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant delivery. Not complainy — genuinely wondering aloud. Voice rises gently at the end, reaching toward her for reassurance. Small and careful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人にわるい事を言ってしまったら謝りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, if you say something unkind to someone, you need to apologize, okay?
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact instruction. Not scolding — just firm and clear. Delivered like something that needs saying, said once and trusted. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんのお話、じつに面白かったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa's stories were really interesting today!
lines.style: Bright enthusiasm, genuine delight. Voice lifts on 「面白かった」. Not showing off — just happy he gets to share something that moved him. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんはていねいに字を書いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, you know how Grandpa writes his characters so carefully, don't you?
lines.style: Appreciative observation shared with him. Slow, almost admiring pace on the detail. Not lecturing — noticing something beautiful together. Voice settles on the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、いまどきの遊びより、外で遊ぶのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I like playing outside better than those modern games, you know?
lines.style: Quiet conviction without defensiveness. Not arguing — just stating something true about himself. A little wonder in it, like he's noticing his own preference as he says it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはことさら静かにお仕事に集中なさるのよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad gets especially quiet and focused when he's working, doesn't he?
lines.style: Observant note, shared understanding. Calm, matter-of-fact delivery. Not criticizing — just naming something she and Sho both understand about him. Respectful undertone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、べつに泣いてないよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm not really crying or anything.
lines.style: Quiet defensiveness, trying to hold composure. Voice steady but with effort underneath. Quick delivery — wanting to move past it. Eyes down or away. Brave little lie.
